background: SMBC Bank International is the London-based bank of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, serving the Japanese group's corporate and institutional clients across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, funded by corporate deposits and the parent.
synthesis: Ratings are A- from Fitch, A from S&P and A1 from Moody's, all stable, with the last move Fitch's downgrade to A- on 8 Dec 2022, and they rest on the Japanese parent. Capital is strong against UK mid-sized banks, with CET1 of 16.6% above the 13.9% median and leverage of 7.7% above 7.4%. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 152% in the bottom quarter against 172% and NSFR of 128% below 135%. Since 31 Dec 2024 leverage has fallen 1.5 points, LCR 10 points and NSFR 6 points, and the figures run to 31 Dec 2025. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
